activity.notes: After Pyrrhus's death in 272 BCE, Antigonus II Gonatas recovered Macedonia and remained king until his death in 239 BCE. This is kept separate from the 277/276-274 BCE reign because the interruption was historically real. The Production canonical Polity identity is reused as Macedon (display: 마케도니아).

sources.title: Antigonus (2), 'Gonatas', c. 320-239 BCE — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: The Oxford Classical Dictionary describes Antigonus's Macedonian kingship, Pyrrhus's 274 BCE occupation, Pyrrhus's death in 272 BCE, and Antigonus's rule through 239 BCE.
